purpose: Offline, bounded diagnostic comparison of frozen source-expectation anchors with raw, static, and host-derived text for exact reused replies plus completed valid expansion replies.

scope_and_limits.expectation_set: Frozen 70 AI-visual observation anchors; 59 source_reading and 11 preserve.
scope_and_limits.observer_capability: This delegate cannot inspect raster images. No scan/image was opened; no image-grounded claim or CER/word-accuracy estimate is made.
scope_and_limits.expectation_authority: The saved expectations were authored by a vision-capable root agent and are marked AI_visual_observation_not_accepted_patch; they remain provisional diagnostic anchors, not human labels, gold, exhaustive transcript, or accepted edits.
scope_and_limits.whole_output_assessment: Not performed. Parent/root separately inspects images and whole outputs.
scope_and_limits.scope: Only exact source IDs present in frozen observation records and ReadingCandidate targets were joined. Raw offsets and hashes are required; no global string search was used. Model output anchors inside host replacement spans were mapped only when deterministic diff boundaries were unique; ambiguous mappings remain unscorable.
scope_and_limits.active_run_limit: Read saved checkpoint exports only. The live attempts store was not opened or polled. Checkpoint 004 is captured 2026-10-25 16:08:51; task state may have changed since that snapshot.

mapping_method.static: ReadingCandidate static_patches and static text; exact raw-offset to static-offset spans reconstructed from the frozen static edit records and checked by ReadingCandidate validation.
mapping_method.derived: Existing host replay derived text/mapping spans. Unchanged spans map linearly. For anchors inside a host replacement span, SequenceMatcher(autojunk=False) maps only unique diff boundaries; insertion-boundary or non-unique mappings are unscorable. This is an AI-provisional diagnostic mapping, not a source-image certification.
mapping_method.raw: Candidate paragraph raw_sha256 and direct half-open [start,end) slice must exactly match frozen observation raw quote.

interpretation: At these exact provisional anchors, the static view retains all 59 recorded source-reading differences and preserves all 11 preserve anchors. The five valid content outputs (new expansion replies) plus four exact reuses cover 25/70 distinct anchors; in 32 attempt-anchor comparisons, 26/27 source_reading comparisons match the recorded expected reading, one is residual, and all 5/5 preserve comparisons retain the expected reading. These are anchor-level exact-span diagnostics only, not a broader quality score; model output agreement with AI observations does not certify scan fidelity.

unassessed_and_failures.note: Invalid, timeout, in-flight, and control attempts are not used as source-reading output. Pending requests are not assessed. A valid missing-image control remains a control result, not a source reading.
